name: TACTIC-DH384-v2

conditional_dyadic_frame.packet_prg: SplitMix64 with the single domain in tactic_v2_common.py
conditional_dyadic_frame.selector_selection: ordinal 17 frozen before every source; no fit, search, retry, or model-dependent choice
conditional_dyadic_frame.pair_map: optional swap and independent signs followed by (u+v,u-v)
conditional_dyadic_frame.normalization: one exact factor 1/64 after twelve stages
decision_dependencies: canonical integer coarse symbols from the same block
forbidden_dependencies: tangent message while choosing the frame
model, layer, expert, checkpoint or provenance identity
conditional_dyadic_frame.finite_linearity: exact signed integer sums/differences with no intermediate rounding or saturation; one public rational output scale

universality_contract.scope: Every canonical SwiGLU-MoE expert triplet; evaluation geometry may be fixed, but the decoder rule is model- and provenance-agnostic
universality_contract.canonicalization: Gate rows, Up rows and transposed Down columns are role-labelled, flattened in row-major order, partitioned into literal 4096-value blocks, and zero-padded only when fixed shape metadata requires it
allowed_decoder_inputs: canonical integer coarse symbols from the same 4096-value block
fixed shape, block position and stage metadata
actually_used_by_frame: canonical integer coarse symbols from the same 4096-value block
the physically transmitted universal selector table
universality_contract.forbidden: No selector fitting, candidate choice, seed retry, lookup by model/layer/expert identity, Qwen table, calibration reference, external expert, or external corpus
universality_contract.packet_construction: The selector is source-free SplitMix64 domain 0x5441435449434448 ordinal 17; all schema/QC/fixture bytes are universal and physically charged
universality_contract.padding_policy: Padding is determined only by fixed shape metadata, is decoded as zero, and every stored padding byte is charged

coarse_lock_contract.held_fd_policy: component-walk O_NOFOLLOW; fstat regular; hash/read same descriptor; hold all component and file descriptors through seal
coarse_lock_contract.path_policy: absolute coarse lock and absent absolute output; record paths are strict relative names below one held root

planning_gate.oracle: arbitrary real coefficients in the exact decoded rank-384 frame
planning_gate.promote: capture - 3*whole_expert_SE >= runtime_c_required and every expert/role fold positive
planning_gate.deterministic_complete_object_stop: accumulated oracle SSE > 0.025 * total source energy
planning_gate.finite_followup: literal 384-bit records, independently decoded Q12 coefficients, F<=0.8, exact rate/read and no overflow

controls.decoded_gaussian: independently row-moment-matched and independently encoded through the exact same finite coarse channel
controls.structure_destroyed: independently energy-preserving sign/permutation source and exact same finite coarse channel
controls.identical_effort: same one universal selector packet, projection, finite search budget, bytes and reads; no panel may fit or choose architecture parameters
controls.interpretation: diagnostic at the continuous stage; a finite source result must beat both controls for final promotion

claim_boundary: One universal exact rank-384 decoded-symbol-conditioned dyadic cell. No payload result, codec achievement, universal decoder converse, composite addition, model-wide result, or launch authority.
